select lower(table_name) as table_name from information_schema.tables where table_schema = '@{pipeline().parameters.schema}'

text.value: select max(@{item().cdc_column}) as cdc from @{item().source_schema}.@{item().source_table} where @{item().cdc_column} > '@{item().updated_at}'

update dbo.control_ETL set last_watermark = '@{activity('latest_watermark').output.resultSets[0].rows[0].cdc}', updated_at = getutcdate(), status = 'Success', last_run_pipeline_id = '@{pipeline().RunId}' where source_table = '@{item().source_table}'
